import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Income distribution by Education
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
education_order = df.groupby('Education')['Income'].median().sort_values().index
sns.boxplot(data=df, y='Education', x='Income', order=education_order, palette='Set2', ax=ax1)
ax1.set_title('Income Distribution by Education Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Income', fontsize=9)
ax1.set_ylabel('Education', fontsize=9)

# 2. Total spending by category
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
spending_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
spending_totals = df[spending_cols].sum()
spending_totals.index = ['Wines', 'Fruits', 'Meat', 'Fish', 'Sweets', 'Gold']
colors_pie = sns.color_palette("Set3", len(spending_totals))
ax2.pie(spending_totals, labels=spending_totals.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors_pie, startangle=90)
ax2.set_title('Total Spending by Product Category', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Age distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
current_year = 2014  # Based on dates in dataset
df['Age'] = current_year - df['Year_Birth']
sns.histplot(data=df, x='Age', bins=20, kde=True, color='steelblue', ax=ax3)
ax3.set_title('Age Distribution of Customers', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=9)
ax3.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=9)

# 4. Purchase channels comparison
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
purchase_channels = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases']
channel_totals = df[purchase_channels].sum()
channel_totals.index = ['Web', 'Catalog', 'Store']
bars = ax4.bar(channel_totals.index, channel_totals.values, color=colors[:3])
ax4.set_title('Total Purchases by Channel', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Purchases', fontsize=9)
ax4.set_xlabel('Channel', fontsize=9)
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax4.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
             f'{int(height)}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 5. Income vs Total Spending scatter
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
df['TotalSpending'] = df[spending_cols].sum(axis=1)
scatter = ax5.scatter(df['Income'], df['TotalSpending'], alpha=0.6, c=df['Age'], cmap='viridis', s=50)
ax5.set_title('Income vs Total Spending', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Income', fontsize=9)
ax5.set_ylabel('Total Spending', fontsize=9)
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax5)
cbar.set_label('Age', fontsize=8)

# 6. Marital Status distribution
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
marital_counts = df['Marital_Status'].value_counts()
ax6.barh(marital_counts.index, marital_counts.values, color=colors[3:3+len(marital_counts)])
ax6.set_title('Distribution by Marital Status', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Count', fontsize=9)
ax6.set_ylabel('Marital Status', fontsize=9)

# 7. Campaign acceptance rates
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
campaign_cols = ['AcceptedCmp1', 'AcceptedCmp2', 'AcceptedCmp3', 'AcceptedCmp4', 'AcceptedCmp5', 'Response']
campaign_acceptance = df[campaign_cols].sum()
campaign_acceptance.index = ['Cmp1', 'Cmp2', 'Cmp3', 'Cmp4', 'Cmp5', 'Response']
ax7.bar(campaign_acceptance.index, campaign_acceptance.values, color=colors[4:4+len(campaign_acceptance)])
ax7.set_title('Campaign Acceptance Rates', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_ylabel('Number of Acceptances', fontsize=9)
ax7.set_xlabel('Campaign', fontsize=9)
ax7.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 8. Kids at home vs Spending
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
df['TotalKids'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']
kids_spending = df.groupby('TotalKids')['TotalSpending'].mean()
ax8.plot(kids_spending.index, kids_spending.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=8, color='coral')
ax8.set_title('Average Spending vs Number of Kids', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_xlabel('Total Kids at Home', fontsize=9)
ax8.set_ylabel('Average Total Spending', fontsize=9)
ax8.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 9. Recency distribution
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
sns.violinplot(data=df, y='Recency', color='lightgreen', ax=ax9)
ax9.set_title('Recency Distribution\n(Days Since Last Purchase)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax9.set_ylabel('Days', fontsize=9)

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Customer Marketing Campaign Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
